title: Design System: RVAP Technical Field Guide

navy-light.displayName: Navy Tint / Hover and Hero Emphasis

category-teal.displayName: Category Dark Teal / M2 and Beginner

display.purpose: Document title; mobile overrides it to 1.55rem. Home and slides have separate title sizes.

heading-small.purpose: Small headings; line height remains inherited from Material.

body.purpose: Shared lab and trainer prose; the captured Material rem gives 17px text.

mono.purpose: Local monospace fallbacks; code blocks use 1.6 line height.

button.purpose: Slide links and trainer controls; hero actions share the type with separate color variants.

label.purpose: Distinct difficulty tints and M1-M5 fills with visible labels; duration stays neutral. Category colors have no Build / Innovate / Scale mapping.

nav.purpose: Native Material navigation and table of contents.

session-tab.purpose: Overview, Lab, and Trainer Guide; mobile labels use .72rem.

table.purpose: Shared lab and trainer tables with normal word wrapping.

set-input.purpose: Native builder inputs, selects, and textarea; also the readonly share link on either set surface.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Supplied navy-tinted shadow on session and track cards.

motion.name: card-transition
motion.purpose: Session and track card hover feedback.

motion.name: curriculum-transition
motion.purpose: Curriculum jump-link hover and current-location feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion override for CSS animation and transition duration; section scrolling becomes instant.

narrative.overview:
The compact full RVAP wordmark and blue navigation anchor the shared white header. The home hero uses the brand's navy-to-blue gradient. Labs and trainer guides keep their white reading surfaces and navy headings, with trainer controls inside the document.

The custom builder and shared viewer inherit this system and the compact logo exception.

**Synthetic tonal ramps are preview aids, not approved palette extensions.**
keyCharacteristics: Shared light reading layout with navy headings.
Aptos font stacks with Outfit and Inter web fallbacks.
Compact RVAP identity and blue current-page states.
Brand-gradient hero with curriculum jump links.

rules.name: The Category Color Rule
rules.body: Use distinct colors for difficulty and M1-M5 badges, with visible names and module numbers. These categories have no Build / Innovate / Scale mapping.

rules.name: The Curriculum Jump Rule
rules.body: Module links jump to session groups. Keep all 19 sessions and six tracks visible; selection must not filter content.

rules.name: The Filter/Selection Rule
rules.body: Builder filters affect only its catalog rows. Keep selected sessions and their order when filters change; clearing filters and clearing selection are separate actions.

rules.name: The URL Set Rule
rules.body: Store the ordered subset and user text in the query string; leave the fragment available for heading anchors.

rules.name: The Logo Rule
rules.body: Use the approved compact full RVAP wordmark in the header and drawer. Keep the 600px minimum displayed width for other full-logo placements. Use a white or very light background, preserve proportions and clear space, and never recolor the artwork.

dos: Do keep labs and trainer guides in the same MkDocs reading system.
Do use Microsoft Blue for small filled actions and ordinary links; use navy for links on tinted reading surfaces.
Do keep table word wrapping normal and overflow local.
Do preserve focus cues, visible content without JavaScript, and opt-in trainer shortcuts.
Do preserve logo proportions and clear space.
Do keep curriculum jump links usable without JavaScript.
donts: Don't invent a dark RVAP theme or reintroduce neon reading surfaces.
Don't assign Build / Innovate / Scale meanings to category badge colors.
Don't extend the compact header/drawer logo exception to other placements.
Don't treat generated preview ramps or unused kit recipes as shipped components.
